references.text: We have all become like something unclean, and all our righteousness is like a menstrual cloth. We all wither like a leaf, and our iniquities carry us away like the wind.

For you do not delight in sacrifice, or I would give it; you have no pleasure in burnt offering. The sacrifice acceptable to God is a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
He has told you, O man, what is good; and what does the Lord require of you but to do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God?
To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.

Yet we know that a person is not justified by works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ. So we also have believed in Christ Jesus, in order to be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law no one will be justified.
God had provided something better for us, so that they should not be made perfect apart from us.
